decision: one prompt queue in the lifecycle holds the launch prompt and later follow-ups
why: the first prompt and follow-ups follow the same send-next rule, so there is one code path instead of two

decision: close the agent process when a run finishes and resume with session/load on follow-up
why: idle agent processes cost memory per finished run, and a daemon restart needs the resume path anyway, so one path covers both

decision: pending permissions are a FIFO list, not a single slot
why: an agent can request permissions for parallel tool calls; a single slot would lose one

decision: stop keeps the clb/<id> branch and deletes only the worktree directory
why: commits the agent made survive stop; only uncommitted changes are discarded

decision: stop on a failed run keeps the failed state and only retries worktree cleanup
why: overwriting failed with stopped hides why the run ended; repeating stop must converge
evidence: lifecycle_test.go stop on a failed run keeps the failure

decision: a graceful shutdown leaves active runs active in the store, and the next start fails them with 'daemon restarted while the run was active'
why: the agent's turn state after a restart is unknown, so resuming could repeat or skip work; failing is honest and fires the webhook
result: a run active at shutdown cannot be continued; launch a new run

decision: after the 10s close wait the daemon removes the worktree or resumes even if Close has not returned
why: Close is bounded by proc.Stop, which sends SIGKILL after its grace period, so the wait expires only for a process that SIGKILL cannot end; blocking forever would wedge the run
result: logged as a warning when it happens

decision: print mode treats a missing result line as failure, forwards non-JSON stdout as stdout events, and builds the summary from the text parts of assistant lines
why: a turn without a result line cannot be told apart from a crash; dropping stray output would hide CLI warnings; assistant lines are assumed to be whole messages
evidence: stream.go Prompt and parseLine; stream tests
result: open item 6: line shapes unverified on the real CLI
